text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (August 16, 2024) for 442 Queen Street West 1

The Property Standards Committee - Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed Item 1 of the Property Standards Order (August 16, 2024) for 442 Queen Street West 1, Folder Number 24 196397 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to December 31, 2024 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City. 2. Confirmed Item 2 of the Property Standards Order (August 16, 2024) for 442 Queen Street West 1, Folder Number 24 196397 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to January 17, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City; if, at that time, the unit is untenanted or the current tenancy agreement does not provide that a washer or dryer are supplied facilities, then no further action is required.
